test_title: PYST 70: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Among all the diplomatic envoys stationed in the conflict zone, (1) / she is undoubtedly more trusted and relied upon (2) / by both factions of the civil war (3) / than any other ambassador. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. she is undoubtedly more trusted and relied upon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence contains a comparison: "she is more trusted and relied upon than any other ambassador."
 
• However, the error lies in the comparative phrase "more trusted and relied upon." For proper grammar, "more trusted" and "relied upon" should match parallel structure.
 
• The correct form should be **"she is undoubtedly trusted and relied upon more."**

Correct sentence: *Among all the diplomatic envoys stationed in the conflict zone, she is undoubtedly trusted and relied upon more by both factions of the civil war than any other ambassador.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Phrases:**
 
 
• Ensure proper parallelism when using comparative phrases like "more trusted and relied upon."
 
• All elements in the comparison should follow the same grammatical structure.
 
 
 
• **Parallelism Rule:**
 
 
• Parallelism requires that items in a list or comparison follow the same form for clarity and grammatical correctness.
 
• Example: She is both "trusted" and "relied upon" (correct parallel structure).
